newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh Capital modifies bid for Arvida.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh Capital modifies bid for Arvida.

text.p: Raleigh Capital Associates LP said Thursday that it will purchase up to 100,000 of the outstanding limited partnership interests of Arvida/JMB Partners LP for $400 cash per unit.

The company said the money will be paid upon closing of the offer, along with an additional $40 cash per unit, upon a determination by the Delaware Chancery Court that the purchaser has voting rights or upon acknowledgment by the general partner that Raleigh, as an assignee of units, has voting rights.

This offer, said the company,is a modification of an earlier one. Raleigh said that it has previously been forced to extend its offer as a result of the General Partner's efforts to deny voting rights of all unitholders other than those who acquired units in the 1987 original public offering.
Raleigh has extended the expiration date of its offer until 0000 EDT/0400 GMT, April 29.
Raleigh said a decision on voting rights from the Delaware Chancery Court is not expected for at least several weeks.
